Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer states that R. B. Bennett was the Prime Minister of Canada when the Toronto Maple Leafs first won the Stanley Cup. The Predicted Answer says Sir Robert Borden was Prime Minister in 1918, when the team (as the Toronto Arenas) won the Stanley Cup. Checking Canadian prime ministers and Stanley Cup history reveals:
- The Toronto franchise first won the Cup in 1918 as the Toronto Arenas.
- The Prime Minister in 1918 was Sir Robert Borden (Borden served from 1911 to 1920).
- R. B. Bennett was Prime Minister much later, from 1930 to 1935, which is not when the Toronto franchise first won the Cup.

Although the Ground Truth Answer is factually incorrect, my task here is only to determine if the Ground Truth Answer ("R. B. Bennett") is present or implied in the Predicted Answer. The Predicted Answer does not mention R. B. Bennett at all and explicitly names Sir Robert Borden.

Decision: FALSE
